<!-- title: The name, its branch too: 1 to 5 lowercase words joined by dashes, such as `branch-cleanup-on-pr-close`. -->

## Situation

<!-- What is true today, as someone who has not followed the work would see it. -->

## Problem

<!-- What goes wrong because of it, and for whom. -->

## Goal

<!-- What is true once this is done, the outcome a person sees. It should take two to four sentences and shall stay within 120 words. Its first sentence, one complete statement of at most 120 characters, becomes the landing title. -->

## Approach

<!-- How it is done. Each premise it states about the code, a term, a capability or a cause, stands on a line of its own, `Premise: <what holds> (checked: <file>:<line> read)`, or with the command run, as a code span, in place of the file and line; `work_tickets.py file` refuses one that names no check. Then a line `Not picked:` naming the alternative and why not. -->

## Base branch

<!-- The branch the work starts from, where it is not the integration branch. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- For a finding from a field report: the report linked, the command and its output verbatim. -->

## Package kind

<!-- standard, discovery (read-only research), breaking (a major release, minor below 1.0.0), or a kind of work, as `route --type` takes it. -->

## Blocked by

<!-- The issues that must be closed first, one `#n` or link per line, or None. -->

## User requirement (verbatim)

<!-- The user's words, quoted exactly. -->

## Design owner

<!-- The files and sections that own the decided behaviour. -->

## Requirements

<!-- Numbered requirements in the order to do them, each one checkable statement (the requirement template); the Acceptance section carries how each is checked. -->

## Changes after filing

<!-- Requirements added after filing, numbered after the last; review open points keep their markers. -->

## File ownership

<!-- Where parallel packages share files: who owns each shared file. -->

## Acceptance

<!-- Checkable items with the evidence expected. -->

## Owner step

<!-- Steps only the owner takes, one item each. -->

## Verification

<!-- The focused tests and real commands to run. -->
